description: Out-the-door quote for one available unit at a named rooftop. Anonymous calls are stateless; authenticated calls persist a deal thread. Anonymous calls persist nothing; quote_preview is the read-only equivalent for browsing. Fee schedules may be incomplete — an unlisted fee is not a guarantee that no such fee applies; confirm final charges with the dealer. Totals are estimates at best; when pricing_coverage is "partial_estimate", present the total as a subtotal excluding the charges in excluded. Always relay pricing_disclosure.

idempotency_key.description: Required when authenticated (durable quote); ignored meaningfully only with an agent key.
